# What do you really keep per hour on a tattoo?

> Tattoo piece profit calculator. Enter the hourly take-home you want, your shop commission or booth rent, setup time, supplies and free touch-ups to see the lowest price for each piece, what you really keep per hour including drawing time, and your shop minimum. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
